title: Gerbe maps to algebraic spaces
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal F$ be a category fibred in groupoids over $\mathit{Sch}/S$ with the functor and 2-isomorphism conventions of [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids], let $Q/S$ be an algebraic space [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $p:\mathcal F\to Q$ be a functor over $\mathit{Sch}/S$. Call $p$ a gerbe map if (1) for every scheme $T/S$ and map $t:T\to Q$, an fppf covering of $T$ [def-pc-fppf-site] admits lifts $x_i:T_i\to\mathcal F$ with $p x_i\simeq t|_{T_i}$, and (2) for every two objects $x,y:T\to\mathcal F$ with $px\simeq py$, an fppf covering of $T$ makes their restrictions 2-isomorphic. Since $Q$ has discrete fibres, these local isomorphisms are automatically compatible with the specified identifications over $Q$. Equivalently every scheme fibre groupoid is fppf locally nonempty and locally connected. The covering topology is the existing big fppf topology; no atlas, stabilizer smoothness or representability of $p$ is part of this predicate.
